sentences.text:
This is third bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C for grant of regular bail in connection with crime No.88/2024 dated : not mentioned, registered at P.S. - Namli, Ratlam for offences punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 & 120-B of IPC.
2.
The first application was dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to revive the application after filing of the charge-sheet vide order dated 29.04.2024 passed in MCRC No.16086/2024.

The second bail application MCRC No.25696/2024 was an application for grant of temporary bail which was allowed by order dated 20.06.2024 by which the applicant was granted temporary bail for a period of 15 days from the date of release.
3. Counsel for the applicant submits that the charge-sheet has been filed and the applicant is in jail since 05.04.2024.

4. As per the prosecution case on 07.03.2024, a written complaint was lodged by complainant Satyaranayan alleging that the land which was registered 2 MCRC-27099-2024 in the name of brother-in-law Jagdish Sharma and after his death his sister and nephew namely Nilesh were residing with the complainant.

On 28.06.2023 when he went to Tehsil for Namantaran of the said land it came to his knowledge that the process of Namantaran of the said land was already initiated by the co-accused persons on the basis of fake and false will on stamp.
5. As per the prosecution case, the forged will was created in the name of Jagdish Chandra Sharma in favour of one Ambika Prasad.

It is alleged that the stamp paper was purchased by co-accused Mukesh Jat vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/161824601/
1 Gowardhan Jat in the name of Jagdish Prasad and he conspired with other co-accused persons in creation of forged will in favour of Ambika Prasad.

entities.text: accused Mukesh Jat vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
It is submitted that co-accused Gowardhan Jat has already been granted bail by order dated 29.04.2024 passed in MCRC No.12170/2024.
6.
Counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been made an accused on the allegation of conspiracy with the accused persons.
He is neither signatory of alleged forged will nor beneficiary of the will.
The only allegation against him is that he had conspired with the accused persons in preparation of the forged will.
7. Counsel for the State opposes the prayer and submits that the applicant has also conspired with the accused persons in preparation of forged will.
8. Counsel for the Objector submits that at the instance of the present applicant, the persons are threatening the complainant to withdraw the complaint and compromise the present case.
In this regard, he has lodged the police report also.

9. After hearing learned counsel for the parties and considering the allegations of conspiracy against the applicant, but there is no evidence of call 3 MCRC-27099-2024 details except the memorandum under Section 27 of the Evidence Act and the applicant is neither signatory of the alleged forged will nor beneficiary, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled for grant of bail on the following conditions:-
A) The applicant shall not threaten the complainant and shall not approach the complainant and witnesses.
B ) The applicant shall mark his presence before the concerned Police Station on every 15th of the month during the pendency of trial.
10.

It is directed that applicant Mukesh shall be released from custody upon furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand Only) with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Ld. Court below.
11. A typed copy of this order is being forwarded to the Office of the Advocate General, on their email address, for intimation to the Police Station concerned.
The office is directed to forward a copy of this order to the Ld. Court below.
12. With the aforesaid, the application is allowed and disposed off.

(VIJAY KUMAR SHUKLA) JUDGE soumya Mukesh Jat vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/161824601/
